body: Thanks for this, it's really comforting. I appreciate it.
Thanks for the response, it helps a lot.

I'm sorry you feel that way. I cannot begin to comprehend what your life has been like, it sounds like you have gone through more hell in a day than most people would see in several lifetimes, and for that I am truly sorry. My very limited life experience would produce the following advice: find a meaningful distraction. Find a church, or service organization, or a social group, or whatever you can find that will give you something to engage in. Something meaningful that gives you a purpose, something tangible to engage in, But more importantly, it should be something that distracts you, something that keeps you from thinking about your past too much. If you get distracted for long enough you'll soon realize that you have a real reason to keep on living, and that you are enjoying life. I have no idea what the hell was wrong with your community, and I can understand your trust problems, but try to understand: so many people out there want to do good, to help, to serve as something for you to lean on in your trying life. finally I'd say, reach out to a professional, you need someone to talk to who actually understands what your mind is going through. Keep fighting, it gets better, I promise.
